Privacy

Privacy and deletion

Voice capture is available only when a transcription provider is configured and starts only after you choose it.

When voice is enabled, audio is sent for transcription and then discarded; Unrot does not store the recording.

We keep your submitted text ideas so we can score the round and calculate rarity.

Your anonymous session id is hashed on the server before storage.

When OpenAI providers are configured, transcription and idea analysis are processed server-side through OpenAI.

When voice is unavailable, typing is the primary input and local analysis keeps scoring available without provider traffic.

Use Delete this attempt on the result page to remove the server attempt and its matching local history entry. The receipt is required.
